title: C'est LaLa Vie Vacation Rental
meta_description: C'est LaLa Vie is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionC'est LaLa VieNatureWalk at Seagrove CommunityFlatwoods Forest Loop, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights: 4 bedrooms and bonus living space at the top of the stairs (see room configurations by selecting “Room Details” tab above) 3 full baths, 1 half bath Sleeps 10 guests Gourmet kitchen with premium appliances Dining Area with seating for 8 Spacious front porch with bed swing Gas GrillTwo suites, each with separate soaker tubs and custom showers in private baths First-floor laundry room with full-sized washer and dryer Two vehicle driveway Four 26" Adult Bikes Included Seasonally (Bikes not included Dec-Feb; additional rentals available upon request)OVERVIEWBeautifully designed for seamless indoor–outdoor living, C’est LaLa Vie is a spacious and stylish retreat perfectly suited for families and groups of up to 10. Located in the highly sought-after NatureWalk at Seagrove community, this home blends coastal charm, modern amenities, and exceptional access to both nature and 30A attractions.COASTAL COMFORT + FAMILY-FRIENDLY FUNCTIONStep into a bright, open-concept layout where the chef’s kitchen—with a large island and premium appliances—overlooks the cozy living room. Whether you're prepping meals, chatting over cocktails, or planning the next beach day, the open design keeps everyone connected.The dining area comfortably seats eight, perfect for family meals or evening board games. A convenient half bath and full laundry room complete the first floor.Two primary suites—one on each level—provide privacy and relaxation, while additional bedrooms and a bonus upstairs living space offer flexible accommodations for adults and children alike.OUTDOOR ADVENTURE + NATUREWALK AMENITIESAs a guest of NatureWalk, you’ll enjoy access to an impressive array of community amenities, including:Resort-style pools + hot tub (Lap Pool heated seasonally per community schedule)Pickleball and basketball courtsFire pits, grilling areas, and The Gathering Place clubhouseMiles of scenic biking and hiking trails through Point Washington State ForestEASY BEACH ACCESSChoose your ideal path to the sand:Lilly Lane Beach Trail – A peaceful boardwalk-style path through the forest leading to San Juan Avenue beach access (approx. 1 mile; features restrooms)395 to 30A – Head straight down County Road 395 to the main Seagrove public access (approx. 2.1 miles)CLOSE TO SEASIDE, WATERCOLOR & ALL OF 30AJust minutes from Seaside, WaterColor, and an array of boutiques, restaurants, and family attractions, C’est LaLa Vie places the best of 30A at your doorstep. Spend your days riding bikes, chasing waves, lounging by the pool, or sipping sunset cocktails on the front porch—this is where unforgettable vacation memories begin.PARKINGDesignated parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway. (No garage access.)RESERVATION & BOOKING POLICYThe cancellation policy in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement (emailed at confirmation) supersedes any third-party site policies.We cannot refund service fees charged by third-party booking platforms.A 5% cancellation fee applies to all cancellations to cover credit card and processing costs.We do not offer a 100% refund at any point after booking.Additional Policies:No SmokingNo Pets (Certified service animals permitted with advance notice and documentation)Ring doorbell camera on premisesPublished rates do not include taxes and fees50% of the total cost is due at bookingRemaining balance due 60 days before arrival (or paid in full if booking within 60 days)Except for the 5% cancellation fee, the initial 50% payment is refundable if cancellation occurs more than 60 days prior to arrivalOptional travel insurance is available; restrictions apply. Must be purchased before final payment.Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTPrimary renter must be at least 25 years of age and must occupy the home for the entire stay
